note: INTERNAL — Wave 8 P1 architecture decisions recorded before implementation of readers (P2). Authored, not generated; scripts/validate-wave8-p1-hidden.ts cross-checks every evidence count below against the generated data.

decisions.decision: Existing-work coverage expansion. Keep the ONE `murasoli-letters` LibraryWork and its `letter` reader structure; Volumes 42–47 are a new source-pinned import feeding that reader in P2. The live Volumes 48–54 payloads stay byte-identical.

evidence.pageRecordDialects: YAML front matter body (Vols 42/43/46/47, most pages) or `## Source text` … `## Archival notes` (Vols 44/45 and a few 42/43 pages); both parsed without rewriting source files
evidence.noSharedPages: no PDF page is shared by two letters in any of the six volumes (each letter is a whole page run)
evidence.identityConstraint: printed numbers are not unique (Vol 46 prints 3637 twice; 3647–3649 recur across Vols 46 and 47): canonical id = m{volume}-{chapter file stem}; routeSlug keeps m{volume}-l{number} where unique in its volume
evidence.englishLayer: released English records only (volume manifest = release authority); translator note, apparatus link lines, per-letter notes and the embedded `Original Tamil` copy are carried separately or excluded — never as English body text
p2Needs: render Tamil from page-segmented text (page boundaries retained)
carry Letter 3681 source-incomplete qualification on the reader and a /source surface

decisions.decision: Stage-play family (`readerStructure: "stage-play"`). The only model gap — a separately titled part with its own numbering scope — is closed additively in data/plays.ts: optional `PlayPart` + `Play.parts` and optional `PlayReadingUnit.partId`. No new reader, no route or registry change at P1; the 10 published plays declare no parts and are unaffected.

evidence.unitIds: source file stems main-01…main-30, nagai-suvai-01…nagai-suvai-03 (supplementary scenes never renumbered 31–33)
evidence.separatedApparatus: Tamil `## Assembly provenance` and English `## Translation notes` sections and source-boundary HTML comments are carried apart from scene text
p2Needs: parse scene text into PlayUnit dialogue / stage-direction units
render the part heading before nagai-suvai-01 and scope scene labels by part

decisions.decision: commentary-unit family (the existing `commentary-unit` ReaderStructure, modelled on the Kuraloviyam unit → page → typed-block payload). NOT kural-commentary. No new ReaderStructure: the P1 typed-block data already preserves every required semantic; P2 extends the commentary-unit block vocabulary additively where needed.

comparison.kural-commentary: REJECTED — a fixed பால் → இயல் → அதிகாரம் → குறள் hierarchy pairing each couplet with a separate commentator voice; சங்கத் தமிழ் has no such hierarchy and is not couplet-plus-commentary.
comparison.tholkappiya-poonga (commentary-unit): Units are numbered மலர் with paragraph-only text; சங்கத் தமிழ் prints no மலர் numbering and needs typed verse / citation / gloss blocks — the page/block model of Kuraloviyam fits better within the same family.
comparison.kuraloviyam (commentary-unit): ADOPTED MODEL — front-matter / entry / back-matter units over physical pages with page types and typed blocks (heading, paragraph[quote], citation, archival, source-limited{handwritten-facsimile}); scan 8 maps directly onto the existing `source-limited` / `handwritten-facsimile` block.

evidence.hierarchy: volume → 104 source-order sections (navigation sections.json) → 115 formal provenance units + 4 source-note-only records (119 leaves) → 497 physical scans, each scan in exactly one section
evidence.verseLineation: every block keeps its source lines exactly (hard-break spaces included); no reflow
evidence.carryOverFragments: right-aligned printed fragments are typed `right-aligned-fragment` (distinct from citations)
evidence.illustrations: illustration / blank / facsimile pages carry the archive's description under an archival label, typed `archival-description` — never source text
evidence.frontBackMatter: front-matter page types typed `front-matter-text`; copy-specific library marks typed `copy-specific-marking`
evidence.printedSourceCitations: every one of the 119 register records is located on its anchor page and typed `source-citation` / `source-note` (Tamil: register match with a recorded tier; English: translated forms on the same anchor pages) — never Kalaignar's text
evidence.quotedClassicalVerse: blockquotes typed `quotation` (the quoted Sangam text), glosses under `பொருள் விளக்கம்` typed `gloss`
evidence.scan8: Tamil `partial` / English `source-limited`, description-only; carried as `sourceLimitation: permanent-source-limited`; handwriting never transcribed or reconstructed
p2Needs: additive commentary-unit block kinds for verse lineation, gloss, ornament and aligned fragments
